privacyIntro: Travedise (“we”, “us”) runs travedise.com and plans tours in Sri Lanka from our offices in Bundeena, NSW, Australia and Galle, Sri Lanka. This policy explains what personal information we collect through this website and when you contact us, how we use it, and the choices you have. We handle personal information in line with the Australian Privacy Principles in the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and Sri Lanka’s Personal Data Protection Act No. 9 of 2022.

privacySections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: You can browse travedise.com without creating an account or giving us your name. We collect personal information only in these situations:
list: When you email or call us, or send the Plan your trip form — your name, contact details and whatever you tell us about your trip, such as travel dates, the number of travellers, preferences and any accessibility or dietary needs.

When you use the live chat on the site — the messages you send and any name or email address you choose to share. The chat is provided by tawk.to, which also records technical details such as your IP address, browser and the page you were on.
When you book a tour with us — the details needed to arrange it, such as passport names, arrival and departure information, and payment records.

Automatically, when you visit — our hosting and security provider, Cloudflare, processes technical data such as your IP address, browser type and the pages requested, to deliver the site and protect it from abuse.

privacySections.heading: How we use your information
paragraphs: We use personal information only to:
list: answer your questions and prepare quotes and itineraries;
arrange and manage your booking with hotels, drivers, guides and other local suppliers;
contact you about your trip before, during and after you travel;
keep the website secure and working properly; and
meet our legal, tax and accounting obligations.

privacySections.heading: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We do not sell or rent personal information. We share it only with the people and services needed to run the site and deliver your trip:
list: travel suppliers in Sri Lanka — hotels, transport providers and guides — who need your details to provide the services you booked;
Zoho Mail, which hosts our email and sends the Plan your trip form to us, with a copy to you;
tawk.to, which provides the live chat;
Cloudflare, which hosts and protects the website; and
authorities, where the law requires us to.

privacySections.heading: Overseas transfers
paragraphs: Because we operate in Australia and Sri Lanka and our service providers run global infrastructure, your information may be stored or processed outside the country you live in, including in Australia, Sri Lanka, the United States and the European Union. We take reasonable steps to make sure these providers protect it.

privacySections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: travedise.com does not use advertising or tracking cookies of its own. The live chat widget sets cookies so that a conversation continues as you move between pages, and Cloudflare may set a strictly necessary cookie to protect the site against bots. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings; the chat may not work without them.

privacySections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep enquiry and booking records for as long as we need them to deliver your trip and to meet legal and accounting requirements, and then delete or de-identify them.

privacySections.heading: Your choices and rights
paragraphs: You can ask us to tell you what personal information we hold about you, to correct it, or to delete it where we no longer need to keep it. You can also ask us to stop contacting you. Email contact@travedise.com and we will respond within 30 days.
If you are not satisfied with how we handled a privacy concern, you can contact the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (oaic.gov.au) or Sri Lanka’s Data Protection Authority.

privacySections.heading: Security
paragraphs: The site is served only over HTTPS, and we limit access to personal information to the people who need it to plan and run your trip. No method of transmitting or storing information is completely secure, so please don’t send passport scans or payment card details by chat.

privacySections.heading: Contact us
paragraphs: Questions about this policy or your personal information: email contact@travedise.com, call +61 426 965 569 (Australia) or +94 76 397 2171 (international), or write to 5/22-30 Brighton St, Bundeena NSW 2230, Australia.
We may update this policy when our website or services change. The date at the top shows when it was last updated.
